source: sources/leads/documented_edges_round10.md idea 2; task brief from orchestrator (agent cleanmig)
what_was_seen_before_writing: market-wide tape gap list (amm_trades and curve_trades, holdout rows excluded)
counts of migrations, filter passers and eligible trades per split and config (no prices, no returns)

data.mayhem: data/processed/mayhem_flags.parquet; is_mayhem True excluded, unknown kept (count reported)
data.reserve: PumpSwap true SOL reserve = pool_sol_logged + 17.585 (re-verified in the sim on train sells)
data.fee: fee_bps of the pool trade that defines the fill state (actual tier at fill time); fee_bps already = LP+protocol+creator

splits.holdout: 1790882100..1790899200 never loaded; every SQL query excludes it

tape_gaps.rule: a gap = > 60 s with no market-wide trade in amm_trades or curve_trades; holdout treated as a gap; declared before P&L
tape_gaps.note: Train has only ~14.6 h of covered tape (Oct 1 12:19-19:15, Oct 2 01:44-07:41 and 16:55-18:49). Validation day is covered from 00:33.

eligibility: token create event recorded, and token create, migration and entry (t_mig + D + 1 s) in ONE covered segment (curve history and entry state complete)
exit time (t_mig + D + H + 1 s) inside a covered segment and before data end; else skipped and counted
whole lifecycle [token create, exit] must not intersect the holdout; such trades are skipped (all Oct 1 pre-holdout migrations with 24 h holds)
holds MAY span a recorder gap (not the holdout) for fixed-time exits: only entry and exit states are needed. The stop variant requires the whole window in one covered segment.

train trades with 24 h holds exit on Oct 3 (validation day) and validation 24 h trades exit on Oct 4-5 (after the validation window). Only those pools' exit prices are read; no decision uses them. Disclosed: train and validation exit periods overlap in calendar time.
one trade per pool per config

filters_point_in_time.computed_from: curve_trades with recv <= t_mig only; wallet balance = net curve buys - sells (transfers invisible)

base.launch_snipers_def: wallets whose first curve buy was in the create slot or create slot + 1; their summed positive net balance / 1e9

filters_point_in_time.strict: base AND holders >= 150 (holder = wallet with net curve balance > 100 tokens)

trade.entry_fill: exact constant product on the last pool state at t_mig + D + 1 s; fee on quote input
trade.exit_fill: exact constant product sell of all tokens on the last pool state at exit + 1 s
trade.stale_state_rule: if the last trade before a fill time lies before the covered segment of that time, use the pre-state of the first later trade in the segment; if none, use the last observed state and flag 'stale'
trade.tx_cost: tip/priority 0.001 SOL per tx (main) and 0.01 (sensitivity), plus 0.000005 SOL base fee per tx; 2 tx per trade

exit: hold 4 h with -40% stop (first pool trade whose post-trade mid <= 0.6 x pre-entry mid; sell at last state at trigger + 1 s)
grid.note: The lead's '24 h with -40% stop' was replaced by '4 h with -40% stop' before any P&L because no 24 h window is fully covered by the tape on train (0 eligible).

sensitivities_reported_not_selected_on: conservative fills (agent_amm_flow rule: entry at the higher of last state and first trade within 5 s; exit at the lower, marked down to next pre-state if >2% lower)
descriptive reference groups at the same D/H: all eligible non-Mayhem standard migrations (unfiltered) and insider graduations (< 20 curve trades)
kill_test: Using train configs with n >= 10: if no config has mean net return (net SOL / 0.5, tip 0.001, main fills) above -2%, stop: verdict FAIL, validation not examined. The lead's median-lift test (filtered 4 h median >= unfiltered + 5 pp) is reported descriptively only.
selection: If the kill test passes: pick ONE config on train = highest net-ex-top-3 SOL (tip 0.001, main fills) among configs with train n >= 10; ties -> larger n. Run validation once for that config only (plus descriptive reference groups).

bar_per_split.also_required_for_pass: conservative-fill net > 0 on the same split

known_limitation: Train n is at most 28 for any config (tape coverage), so the train bar (n >= 50) cannot be met. Therefore the best possible verdict from this study is INCONCLUSIVE (validation evidence only), never PASS/candidate. A validation pass would justify forward collection, not a candidate.

verdict_rules.FAIL: kill test fails, or the chosen config fails the bar on validation (net <= 0 or PF <= 1.2 or net ex top3 <= 0)
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: chosen config passes validation bar but train n < 50 (unavoidable here), or validation n < 50
verdict_rules.PASS: not reachable in this study (see known_limitation)

rug_definition: trade net return <= -90% of stake (before tips)
reporting: per-trade distribution, by entry hour UTC, skip reasons, rugs and losses
